annotations.title: Ask to replace every key Gemmein issued for this app

description: Asks the founder to replace every key Gemmein issued for this app — Development and Live, in one action: every secret server key, every relay's Gemmein-minted signing secret, every external AI tool's signing secret, and the site preview link. Every old value stops working the moment they approve it. None of the new values reach this chat — they're on the dashboard's API keys, Relays, AI tools and Site pages afterward. Use this after a real security concern (a leaked key, a compromised machine) — not routine housekeeping; a single key or secret is better replaced on its own page. This is a change to how the business runs: your human approves it in their browser with the code Gemmein emails (and, when they set one up, their authenticator app's code). Nothing changes until they approve; approving it carries it out — Gemmein does it the moment they press Approve, once, and records what happened on their Logs. The approval page shows Gemmein's own sentence of the real effect, read against Live; a request that no longer matches Live when it is carried out is refused and nothing changes. Returns the approval link for your human and a handle: live_action_status with wait: true answers the moment it is done, or why not — never ask your human to tell you they approved. A second call asks again (a new approval).
